name: secure-ai-pipeline
description: Catch AI-generated security mistakes mid-conversation: hallucinated / slopsquatting packages, insecure code patterns, and CVE-laden dependencies.
long_description: Exposes the Secure AI Pipeline checks as MCP tools the assistant can call BEFORE it installs a dependency or hands you generated code. Every tool returns a verdict (block / warn / ok). Anti-slopsquatting package verification (verify_install, check_package), snippet SAST (sast_scan), dependency CVE checks (sca_scan), a combined gate (full_scan), and a full multi-tool repo scan (scan_repo). No accounts, no SaaS — it runs locally.

tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Verify a package exists on PyPI or npm before installing it (anti-slopsquatting)

tools.name: verify_install
tools.description: Check every package in an install command (pip/npm/yarn/pnpm/uv) before running it

tools.name: sast_scan
tools.description: Scan a code snippet for insecure patterns

tools.name: sca_scan
tools.description: Check pinned dependency versions for known CVEs

tools.name: full_scan
tools.description: Run package + SAST + SCA checks with one blocking decision

tools.name: scan_repo
tools.description: Full multi-tool security scan of a project directory

prompts.name: secure_review
prompts.description: Make the assistant verify deps + scan generated code before finalizing
